info.description: Community-maintained OpenAPI description of the interactions listed in Open Health Hub's FHIR R4 capability statement. This gateway focuses on workflows around FHIR questionnaires rather than the full FHIR resource set. This document models JSON representations only. Resource payloads remain open FHIR objects; use provider profiles for their constraints. The provider recommends using an FHIR library because resources can gain fields and extensions.
